en.content: A mass M hangs on a massless rod of length l which rotates at a constant angular frequency. The mass M moves with steady speed in a circular path of constant radius. Assume that the system is in steady circular motion with constant angular velocity . The angular momentum of M about point A is LA which lies in the positive z direction and the angular momentum of M about point B is LB. The correct statement for this system is :

options.content: L<sub>A</sub> is constant, both in magnitude and direction
L<sub>B</sub> is constant in direction with varying magnitude
L<sub>B</sub> is constant, both in magnitude and direction
L<sub>A</sub> and L<sub>B</sub> are both constant in magnitude and direction

en.explanation:
Net force on M is towards A, hence torque is zero about A.



as so LA = constant
